strings.name: Lang Ping
strings.role: Volleyball outside hitter · Former China and USA coach
strings.summary: Known as the Iron Hammer, Lang helped China win the World Cup, World Championship and 1984 Olympic gold before becoming an international coach. She led China to silver in 1996, the United States to silver in 2008 and China to gold in 2016. Combining playing experience, systematic training and team development, she became a major figure in international women's volleyball.
